title: Confirm per-day economies are valid economyDeduction pools (olc5.13.5 follow-up)
description: The shared deduction contract (packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts, economyDeductionViolation) treats economy kinds charges and per-day as numeric pools whose remaining count a deduction may lower. Only the Cube charges economy uses this today. Confirm from source that a per-day economy can be drained by an external event and that its dawn reset semantics are unaffected; otherwise restrict NUMERIC_POOL_KINDS to charges.
notes: 2026-10-17 captain: per-day removed from deductible pool kinds (source: only Cube charges). PR opened; bead stays in_progress until merge.
